introHtml: Steel salt and pepper shakers offer a sleek, durable alternative to ceramic or plastic options. The brushed metal finish resists chipping and stands up to heavy use in commercial kitchens, break rooms, or outdoor events. These shakers accept crisp laser engraving or screen printing for your logo, making them a practical giveaway for food industry clients or company picnics. Choose from stainless or painted steel to match your brand colors.
